integrity: The facet list is transcribed from Benedetti--Lutz Theorem 6.3 and checked by the published face vector. The bundled verifier performs an exhaustive recursion from definitions; no randomized search or external certificate is trusted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the published 14-vertex Rudin ball. It does not classify complete non-evasive decision trees or assert analogous robustness for other balls. The 57Q15 ownership is supplied by the Benedetti--Lutz source whose primary MSC is 57Q15; Rudin's 1958 paper is the earliest verified public source for the underlying triangulation.
title: Every vertex of Rudin's ball is a non-evasive first move
